mentions.name: pg-fs
mentions.description: pg-fs is a Postgres-backed file system abstraction for AI agents, giving agents their familiar file primitives on top of Postgres. A version of it powers a local store for rubber duck thoughts and voice notes, working like an explicit ChatGPT-style memory store so finding the needle in the haystack later is easy.
mentions.problem: AI agents lack familiar file primitives, and personal notes/information suffer from 'information FOMO' because finding the needle in the haystack is hard.
mentions.audience: AI agents (used via developers building agents); the author also runs a version personally for a local store of thoughts and voice notes
